mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the venous valves was most worthwhile: the planned picture connects their direction of action with compression by limb muscles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the thin-walled veins felt least substantial; the description distinguished their appearance but gave little functional explanation at that point.

surprise.text: The venous-return picture added contracting limb muscle to the valve explanation, making return flow more concrete than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the final two connections were the only offered combinations rather than meaningful choices. Arterioles appeared without explanation in the branching description.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter to see how these vessel routes connect to circulation, though I would hope for fuller explanations of intermediate structures.
